ballPolicy: The separate ball remains with the opponent before tick5. After the steal, the Moxie-specific ball track brings the acquired ball to her hand. The sprites never draw a ball.

review.reviewNotes: Eight distinct full-body Moxie defensive-steal poses. Moxie’s pale human face, lavender eyes, long high lavender ponytail/gold tie, purple/silver kit and shoes are consistent. Pose3 is the waist-level steal contact; both hands remain empty and readable. No ball is drawn.
